fields.name: powerUpClip
fields.tooltip: One-shot on a boost orb pickup (FX bus). Empty = silent.

fields.name: powerUpPitchBand
fields.tooltip: Pitch of the pickup at a green (1×) orb .. at a purple (10×) orb, on a log scale so blue (2.5×) lands at 0.4 of the band.

fields.name: brakeClip
fields.tooltip: One-shot on a brake pad hit (FX bus). Empty = silent — the default: brakes are not power-ups.

fields.name: engineClip
fields.tooltip: The engine loop (FX bus). Empty = silent.

fields.name: engineVolumeBand
fields.tooltip: Loop volume at a standstill .. at Light Speed — the engine gets stronger the faster the ship goes.

fields.name: enginePitchBand
fields.tooltip: Loop pitch at a standstill .. at Light Speed.

fields.name: engineResponse
fields.tooltip: How sharply the loop follows the speed: the smoothing of the speed term (higher = snappier). Real time.

fields.name: engineFadeSeconds
fields.tooltip: How long the loop takes to drop out when the sim freezes (run over, tuning screen) and to come back on a relaunch. Real time.

fields.name: engineFollowsClock
fields.tooltip: Multiply the loop's pitch by the world clock, so the loop's slow motion drags the engine down with the picture. Unity never ties pitch to timeScale on its own.

fields.name: jumpClip
fields.tooltip: One-shot the frame the ship leaves a ramp's lip (FX bus). Empty = silent.

fields.name: dashClip
fields.tooltip: One-shot on a lateral dash on the track (FX bus). An airborne dash is a barrel roll and plays the roll clip instead. Empty = silent.

fields.name: barrelRollClip
fields.tooltip: One-shot the frame an airborne dash starts its barrel roll (FX bus). Empty = silent.

fields.name: explosionClip
fields.tooltip: One-shot as the ship explodes at 0 hull (FX bus). Empty = silent.

fields.name: laserHitClip
fields.tooltip: One-shot as the ship flies through a laser beam and the hit lands (FX bus). Empty = silent.
